# 03 — Database and Architecture Changes

## Migrations (additive only; generated by drizzle-kit; reviewed before running)

### `drizzle/0005_security_privacy_gifts.sql`
- New tables: `pen_mutes` (PK muter+author), `gift_claims` (unique `order_item_id`, unique `token_hash`, indexes on recipient+status and purchaser), `identity_shares` (unique `slug`).
- New columns: `comments.as_pseudonym boolean default false`, `posts.pen_name text`.
- New indexes: `blocks(blocked_id)`, `mutes(muted_id)`, `comments(author_id)`, `posts(group_id, created_at)`, `reports(target_type, target_id, status)` — each matches a query identified in the audit.

### `drizzle/0006_gamification_engine.sql`
- New tables: `quest_claims` (PK user+quest+period), `vibe_checkins` (PK user+local_date), `season_claims` (PK user+season+track+milestone).
- `xp_ledger`: `meta jsonb default '{}'`, `reverses_id uuid` with unique index (an award can be reversed once).

No column was dropped, renamed or retyped; no data transformation. Foreign keys are rewritten to the app schema by the existing `migrationsFor()` when `DATABASE_SCHEMA` is set.

### Verification
- Every integration test builds a fresh in-memory database and runs all migrations (0000–0006) — 20+ test files, each passing.
- Local dev DB (`.data/pglite`) migrated on first start of the new build; backed up first to `.data/pglite-backup-before-0005-0006`.
- Production Supabase: **not contacted** (no credentials present locally; rule respected).

## Data (not schema) changes at boot
- `MODULE_SCOPE=launch` (default outside tests): writes a flag row per non-core module and one `platform_settings` marker `module_launch_scope_v1` the first time; legacy modules set off. Reversible in Admin → Flags. Tests use `MODULE_SCOPE=all`.

## Architecture
Still a modular monolith (Fastify + Drizzle + PostgreSQL/PGlite + React SPA). New domain services rather than logic in handlers:

| Domain | New/changed module |
|---|---|
| Module control | `src/shared/modules.ts` (registry), `src/server/services/modules.ts` (cache, launch scope), request hook in `app.ts`, `src/web/lib/modules.tsx` |
| Pen-name privacy | `muteFilters`, `penMuteRef`, `serializeComments` in `modules/social.ts` |
| Events privacy | `services/events.ts` |
| Gifts | `services/gifts.ts`, `modules/gifts.ts` |
| Progression | `shared/progression.ts` (pure), `services/progression.ts`, `modules/progression.ts` |
| Identity | `shared/personality.ts` quality-v1; timeline + shares in `modules/studio.ts` |
| Social | `shared/commonGround.ts` |
| Link previews | `services/shell.ts` |
| Monetisation contracts | `shared/monetisation.ts` |

### Module dependency map
```
core (always on): identity · thoughts · rituals · gamification · referrals · auth/account · safety/moderation
default on (switchable): circles · play · premium (preview while payments off) · astrology (optional)
default off (legacy): community → (groups/stories)   messages
                      dating → messages            matchmaking → astrology, messages
                      experts   learning   marketplace   weddings
shared infrastructure never switched: users/sessions, uploads/storage, notifications, payments core, moderation reports
```

## Config
- `PAYMENTS_ENABLED` (default `false`): required for any live provider.
- `MODULE_SCOPE` (`launch` | `all`; default `launch`, `all` under `NODE_ENV=test`).
- `WEB_DIST_DIR` (optional): serve an alternative web build (used by isolated e2e).
